purpose: Teach: チューナー/チェックポイント/オペレーター/コントローラー/ビデオテープ/サイコロ/バーナー/ホーン

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社用テレビのチューナー交換を進めろ
lines.en: Get the company TV tuner replacements moving.
lines.style: Sharp, clipped authority. No excess breath. Direct eye contact. Each word lands clean and businesslike. Expectation of compliance is built into the cadence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。物流ルートにチェックポイントを増設します
lines.en: Understood. I'll add checkpoints to the distribution route.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slight pause after yes—gathering the instruction. Measured delivery, professional. Shows he's already processing the task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、コールセンターのオペレーター研修を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen the call centre operator training.
lines.style: Steady directive, same firm baseline as before. Lean forward slightly on 'strengthen'—not a suggestion, an order. Voice carries the weight of expectation without needing to raise volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。生産ラインのコントローラー更新を計画します
lines.en: Understood. I'll plan an update to the production line controller system.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. Small beat of processing. Professional but with a slight undercurrent of something—a tiny register shift, like he's mentally flagging something. Not confusion, just notation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社史用ビデオテープのデジタル化を進めろ
lines.en: Get the company historical videotapes digitised.
lines.style: Same authoritative register as the first directive. Brisk, final. The tone of someone used to being obeyed. No softening, no elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員研修にサイコロゲームを導入します
lines.en: Understood. I'll introduce a dice game to the staff training program.
lines.style: Quick confirmation with a very slight hesitation—the tiniest beat of internal pause, as if double-checking what he just heard. Then compliant delivery. Professional mask held steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業務用バーナーの安全点検を毎月実施しろ
lines.en: Institute monthly safety inspections on the commercial burners.
lines.style: Firm, methodical delivery. Voice settles lower on 'safety'—this one carries real weight. Not harsher, but more deliberate. The instruction of someone who knows what happens when corners are cut.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場のホーン警報の音量を調整します
lines.en: Understood. I'll adjust the factory horn alarm volume.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Polite closure. Breath slightly lighter—end of the exchange approaching. Professional nod in the voice. Compliant but not robotic.
